serviceTitle.description: Its title, from this module's projection.

status.description: Where it is in its life.

customerNote.description: Note the customer wrote, if any.

adminNote.description: Internal note; never shown to the customer.

cancellationReason.description: Why it was called off, if it was.

hasConflict.description:
Whether this REQUEST overlaps an already-confirmed appointment.

Computed for the calendar so a doomed request is shown as such: confirming
it would be refused by the database, and finding that out by clicking is a
poor way to learn it.

history.description: What happened to it, oldest first.

AdminAppointmentDto.description:
An appointment as the ADMINISTRATION sees it: everything, including who
booked it and the internal note.

slug.description: URL segment of the public page.

shortDescription.description: One line, used on the showcase cards.

description.description: Long text of the detail page.

durationMinutes.description: Length of one appointment, or null.

price.description: Price, or null when it is not published.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the price, or null.

sortOrder.description: Position in the showcase; lower comes first.

isArchived.description: Whether it has been withdrawn from the catalogue.

images.description: Gallery, ordered as it is shown.

AdminServiceDto.description:
A service as the ADMINISTRATION sees it: every field, including the ones
that decide whether the public sees anything at all.

It is a separate shape from PublicServiceDto on purpose.
Sharing one DTO between the two audiences means a new administrative field
is published to anonymous visitors by default, and nothing fails when that
happens.

oneOf.description: Status before, or null for the booking itself.

fromStartUtc.description: Start before, or null for the booking itself.

AppointmentHistoryDto.description: One line of an appointment's history.

AppointmentStatus.description:
Where an appointment is in its life.

             Stored and serialized as its NAME, never as an ordinal: inserting a value
             in the middle would otherwise silently change the meaning of every row
             already written and every integer in flight.

             The legal moves are:
             ```Requested → Confirmed → Completed
    ↓           ↓
Cancelled   Cancelled / NoShow```
             Anything else is refused by Appointment, not by a comment.

storageFileId.description:
Identifier returned by `POST /api/files`. Upload it as a PUBLIC file:
a private one cannot be shown to an anonymous visitor.

altText.description: What the image shows, for anyone who cannot see it. Required.

sortOrder.description: Position in the gallery; lower comes first.

userId.description: Account that acted, or null when anonymous.

correlationId.description: Correlation id, to join with the logs.

AuditEntryDto.description: Audit entry as exposed to clients.

accessToken.description: Signed JWT to send as a Bearer header.

AuthResponse.description:
Body returned by register, login and refresh.

Deliberately does NOT contain the refresh token: that travels only in an
httpOnly cookie, out of reach of any script (XSS containment). The access
token is meant to be held in memory by the client, never persisted.

serviceTitle.description: Its title, so the page can name it in one call.

timeZoneId.description:
The business time zone. The client needs it to say "09:00 our time" rather
than converting into the visitor's own zone and quietly booking them for
the wrong hour in their head.

days.description: One entry per day of the requested range.

AvailabilityDto.description: The answer to "when can I book this service?".

isClosed.description: Whether the business is shut that day.

startLocal.description: Local opening time of the extraordinary window, "HH:mm".

endLocal.description: Local closing time of the extraordinary window, "HH:mm".

reason.description: Why. Administration only; a visitor never sees it.

AvailabilityOverrideDto.description: One closure or extraordinary opening, as exposed to the administration.

AvailabilityRuleDto.description: One weekly opening, as exposed to the administration.

timeZoneId.description: The business time zone these times are local to.

AvailabilitySettingsDto.description:
The whole availability configuration, read and written as one document.

One shape rather than per-row endpoints because that is how it is edited:
a weekly schedule is thought about, and saved, as a whole. Saving one rule
at a time turns "move Tuesday to the afternoon" into three requests that
can half-fail.

date.description: The date, LOCAL to the business time zone, as "yyyy-MM-dd".

slots.description:
Bookable slots, in order. An EMPTY list is meaningful and is why closed
days are returned at all: a calendar has to grey out a Sunday, and a
missing day is indistinguishable from a day nobody asked about.

reason.description: Why they are calling it off.

CancelMyAppointmentRequest.description:
Body of the customer's cancel endpoint. Optional: a customer explaining
themselves is a courtesy, not a requirement.

reason.description:
Why. Required here, because the customer reads it: "cancelled" with no
explanation is the message that makes someone stop booking.

CancelRequest.description: Body of the administration's cancel endpoint.

id.description: Stable identifier, prefixed by the owning module ("users.total").

title.description: Short label shown above the value.

value.description: Formatted primary value for a stat widget.

link.description: Optional in-app route the tile navigates to.

order.description: Sort hint; lower comes first, ties broken by title.

DashboardWidget.description: A tile contributed to the dashboard by a module.

detail.description: Secondary text, e.g. a timestamp or actor.

DashboardWidgetItem.description: One entry of a DashboardWidgetKind.List widget.

DashboardWidgetKind.description: Shape a widget takes on screen.

text.description: Text to echo. Required, max 500 characters (see validator).

EchoCommand.description:
Sample command proving validation and event publishing end-to-end.
Echoes the given text back and publishes DemoEchoedEvent.

length.description: Length of the echoed text, in characters.

FileVisibility.description:
Who may download a stored file.

Decided at UPLOAD and explicitly: there is no endpoint that changes it
afterwards, because "make this public" is the kind of one-click action
that turns a mistake into a disclosure with no review step in between.
Re-upload instead — the bytes are cheap, the mistake is not.

The enum travels as a NAME in JSON (the host registers
`JsonStringEnumConverter`), so inserting a value here never changes
the meaning of a value already stored or in flight.

name.description: Name shown in a language picker, in that language.

LoginCommand.description: Authenticates an account with email and password.

notificationId.description: The notification to mark, or null for all.

serviceTitle.description: Its title, from this module's projection.

status.description: Where it is in its life.

customerNote.description: Note the customer wrote, if any.

cancellationReason.description: Why it was called off, if it was.

canCancel.description:
Whether the customer may still call it off themselves. Computed by the
server: the cutoff is configuration, and the client must not have to know
it — the API stays the boundary that enforces it either way.

MyAppointmentDto.description:
An appointment as its OWNER sees it.

It deliberately has no `AdminNote` field. Not "we remember to strip
it" — the shape simply cannot carry it, so it cannot leak by omission.

isUnread.description: Whether the user has not read it yet.

NotificationDto.description: A notification as exposed to clients.

NotifyMeCommand.description:
Sends the caller a notification.

Exists so the realtime path is demonstrable and testable end to end: it
publishes a notification request exactly as any real feature would, and
everything after that — persistence, the realtime push, the badge and the
toast — happens without this module knowing any of it exists.

timestampUtc.description: Server UTC time at which the query was handled.

PingResponse.description:
Response contract of PingQuery (exposed by the API and,
through OpenAPI, by the generated SDK).

id.description: Identifier of the service, used by the booking flow.

shortDescription.description: One line, used on the showcase cards.

description.description: Long text of the detail page.

durationMinutes.description: Length of one appointment, or null.

price.description: Price, or null when it is not published.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the price, or null.

images.description: Gallery, ordered as it is shown; the cover comes first.

PublicServiceDto.description:
A service as an anonymous visitor sees it.

It carries no publication state at all: everything reachable through the
public endpoints is, by construction, published and not archived, so
there is no flag a caller could try to flip.

password.description: Raw password; hashed before persistence, never stored.

RegisterCommand.description: Creates a new account and signs it in.

startUtc.description: Start instant chosen from the offered slots, UTC.

contactPhone.description: Number to reach the customer on for this booking.

RequestAppointmentCommand.description: A customer asks for an appointment.

startUtc.description:
New start instant, UTC. The duration is not settable: moving a booking
chooses WHEN, it does not redefine what was sold.

isBuiltIn.description: Whether the framework owns the role (not deletable).

exceptions.description: The complete list of closures and extra openings.

SaveAvailabilitySettingsCommand.description:
Replaces the whole availability configuration.

A wholesale replace rather than per-row endpoints, because that is how a
weekly schedule is thought about and edited: "Tuesdays move to the
afternoon" is one decision, and splitting it into three requests invites
the state where the first two applied and the third did not.

website.description:
Honeypot. A real visitor never sees this field and therefore leaves it
empty; automated submitters fill every input they find. When it carries a
value the submission is dropped and still answered with success — telling
a bot it was detected only teaches whoever wrote it to try again.

A honeypot instead of a captcha: no third-party dependency, no cognitive
load for the visitor, and it stops the bulk of automated traffic. A captcha
is a reasonable next step if the logs ever show it is needed — not before.

SendContactMessageCommand.description: A message written by an anonymous visitor on the public contact form.

id.description: Identifier of the association, used to detach it.

storageFileId.description:
Identifier of the file in the Storage module. The client builds the image
URL from it against Storage's public endpoint; this module never serves
bytes.

isCover.description: Whether it is the image used on cards and previews.

ServiceImageDto.description: One picture of a service, as exposed to any client.

slug.description:
URL segment of the public page. Leave it empty and it is derived from the
title, disambiguated if needed; provide one and it is used verbatim, or
rejected when already taken.

shortDescription.description: One line, shown on the showcase cards.

description.description: Long text of the detail page.

durationMinutes.description:
Length of one appointment. Required when IsBookable is
set, because it is what generates the bookable slots.

price.description: Price, or null to publish no price at all.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; required when a price is given.

sortOrder.description: Position in the showcase; lower comes first.

ServiceWriteModel.description:
The editable fields of a service, as they travel in a create or edit
request.

One shape for both operations because the two forms are the same form:
splitting them would mean maintaining two validators that must agree, and
the day they stop agreeing is the day a rule holds on creation only.

value.description: Raw value; must parse as the setting's declared type.

isOverriddenByUser.description: Whether the caller has their own value.

SettingDto.description: One effective setting as seen by the caller.

roleNames.description: The complete new set of role names.

SetUserRolesRequest.description: Body of the "set user roles" endpoint.

startUtc.description: Start instant, UTC. The browser renders it locally.

SlotDto.description: One bookable slot, as offered to a client.

id.description: Public identifier used to download or delete.

contentType.description: Content type declared at upload; metadata only.

visibility.description:
Who may download it. A `Public` file is reachable without a token at
`/api/files/public/{id}` — that is the URL to put in an
`<img src>`.

StoredFileDto.description:
File metadata as exposed to clients. The storage key is never included:
it is an internal detail of the provider.

jobTitle.description: New job title, or null to clear it.

roles.description: Role names granted to the account.

permissions.description: Every permission the account effectively holds.

UserAuthorizationDto.description:
Effective authorization of an account: its roles and the union of their
permissions. Returned by the "my permissions" endpoint the frontend uses
to drive the UI.

UserDto.description:
Account identity exposed to clients. Entities never cross the API
boundary; this DTO is what OpenAPI (and therefore the SDK) sees.

It carries no roles or permissions on purpose: those belong to the
Authorization module and are served by `GET /api/authorization/me`.
Returning them here would create a second source of truth that silently
goes stale.

UserProfileDto.description: User profile as exposed to clients.
